chunks: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali (peace be upon him) entrusted us with Abu al-Khalil Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr.
So he would narrate to us from him.

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali (Imam al-Sadiq)
key_terms.عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي: Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr

ai.seo_question: Who was entrusted by Imam al-Sadiq to narrate hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Kamal al-Din* underscores the concept of *tawqi'* (authorization), where Imam al-Sadiq (AS) specifically designated Abu al-Khalil as a trusted conduit for transmitting his teachings, thereby validating the reliability of the chain (*isnad*) during the Minor and Major Ghaibah. It highlights the scholarly principle that the authenticity of hadith in Shia tradition relies not only on the text but on the verified transmission through appointed deputies and narrators. This mechanism ensures the continuity of divine guidance and jurisprudential authority from the Imams to the broader community.
